editorial:
Imagine waking up and looking in the mirror only to see a giant head of cabbage where your face should be. That is exactly what happens to the unlucky main character in this wild ride. You get to follow him as he tries to navigate a normal day in Tokyo while looking like a vegetable. The vibe is totally surreal and funny, making you wonder how people around him react. Some people think he is a joke, others want to eat him, and some just get angry for no reason. It is a strange setup that keeps you guessing about what will happen next.

What really works here is the silly acting and the way the movie mocks how society treats people who are different. The pacing is a bit slow in some spots, but the weirdness makes up for it. If you like movies that feel like a fever dream, you will love this one.
endingExplained: In the end, you see that the cabbage head is not just a random accident but a reflection of how the character felt invisible in his own life. After a series of chaotic events and funny fights, he finally accepts his weird state. The movie wraps up with him finding a small group of friends who like him for who he is, regardless of his vegetable head, proving that being different is actually okay.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves strange stories and quirky humor.
